Container.Name: virtual-dsm
Container.Overview: Virtual DSM in a Docker container.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Port for the DSM web interface, ex. `5000`. Change it if another container already uses 5000 on this server.

Config.Name: HTTPS Port
Config.Description: Optional: Port for the DSM web interface over HTTPS, ex. `5001`. Only needed if you use HTTPS inside DSM.

Config.Name: VM Disk Size
Config.Description: Optional: Size of the main data disk, ex. `256G` or `1T`. Increasing it later grows the existing disk without data loss. Default is `256G`

Config.Name: RAM Size
Config.Description: Optional: Amount of RAM assigned to DSM, ex. `2G`, `4G`, `half` or `max`. Give more if you run packages like Surveillance Station or Synology Photos. Default is `2G`

Config.Name: CPU Cores
Config.Description: Optional: Number of virtual CPU cores, ex. `2`, `4`, `half` or `max`. More cores help with indexing and many cameras. Default is `2`

Config.Name: DHCP Mode
Config.Description: Optional: Set to `Y` to let DSM get its own IP address from your router, ex. when using a custom `br0` network. Requires the VHost device. Default is `N`

Config.Name: Disk Location
Config.Description: Optional: Host folder for the DSM disk images, ex. `/mnt/user/domains/dsm`. Set it so the disks live on your array or cache instead of inside the Docker image.

Config.Name: Preallocation
Config.Description: Optional: Set to `Y` to reserve the full disk size up front, ex. to make sure the space stays available on the array. With `N` the disk only uses the space DSM actually fills. Default is `N`

Config.Name: Disk format
Config.Description: Optional: Disk image format, ex. `raw` (fastest) or `qcow2` (growable file). Default is `raw`

Config.Name: DSM Version URL
Config.Description: Optional: URL or local path of a `.pat` file to install a specific DSM version, ex. `https://global.synologydownload.com/download/DSM/release/7.4.1/90080/DSM_VirtualDSM_90080.pat`. Only used for a new installation, existing installs update through DSM itself.

Config.Name: Host Model
Config.Description: Optional: Model of your Synology NAS reported to DSM, ex. `DS920+`. Set it together with the other host and guest fields to retrieve or transfer licenses linked to your Synology Account.

Config.Name: Host Serial
Config.Description: Optional: Serial number of your Synology NAS, ex. `XXXXXXXXXXXXX`, as shown on its label or in Control Panel - Info Center. Needed for Synology Account licensing.

Config.Name: Host MAC
Config.Description: Optional: MAC address of your Synology NAS, ex. `00:11:32:XX:XX:XX`, as shown in Control Panel - Info Center - Network. Needed for Synology Account licensing.

Config.Name: Guest Serial
Config.Description: Optional: Serial number of a Virtual DSM created in Virtual Machine Manager on your Synology NAS (one free Virtual DSM license per host), ex. `XXXXXXXXXXXXX`. Needed to transfer purchased DSM and Surveillance Station licenses.

Config.Name: Guest MAC
Config.Description: Optional: MAC address of that Virtual DSM, ex. `02:11:32:XX:XX:XX`, used for the guest network adapter. Keep it fixed so DSM keeps its identity and DHCP lease.

Config.Name: KVM
Config.Description: Hardware virtualization device, required to run DSM at near-native speed.

Config.Name: TUN
Config.Description: Network tunnel device, required for the container's default NAT networking.

Config.Name: VHost
Config.Description: Kernel network acceleration device, required when DHCP Mode is `Y`.
